definitions.explanation: Sharing a residence with someone else, whether family members, a partner, or roommates.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}と{同居|どうきょ}している。
examples.english: I live together with my girlfriend.

examples.japanese: {親|おや}と{同居|どうきょ}するか{悩|なや}んでいる。
examples.english: I'm wondering whether to live with my parents.

examples.japanese: {結婚|けっこん}{前|まえ}に{同居|どうきょ}を{始|はじ}めるカップルも{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Many couples start living together before marriage.

notes:
{同居|どうきょ} can refer to various living arrangements.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {同居|どうきょ}する (to live together)
- {同居|どうきょ}{人|にん} (cohabitant, person living together)
- {同居|どうきょ}{家族|かぞく} (family members living together)
- {親|おや}と{同居|どうきょ} (living with parents)

VERB FORM:
- {同居|どうきょ}する (to live together, to cohabit)

RELATED TERMS:
- ルームシェア: room sharing
- {一人暮|ひとりぐ}らし: living alone
- {二世帯住宅|にせたいじゅうたく}: two-family home
